item.title: Publish facts AI agents can trust, instead of what they scraped
Show HN: FAB – A benchmark for AI agents doing financial due diligence
item.description:
The world economy around us depends on complex financial work. How well can AI do it?

We(a team of ex-EY employees) built FAB - Finance Agents Benchmark, testing AI Agents on the work behind financial due diligence. Agents can find the relevant facts, but still struggle to carry them through to a complete, reliable analysis.

We’ll keep expanding FAB to more companies and testing more models. Building and running this benchmark isn’t cheap, so we’re scaling it in stages.

The benchmark is public.

GitHub: Hugging Face: https://github.com/SecondState-ai/finance-agents-benchmark data room and tasks: https://huggingface.co/datasets/secondstate/finance-agents-b...

item.title: Ask HN: Using AI to develop software while being Anti-AI
item.description:
Hey yall, so I've kinda started understanding why people tend to hate on AI, I found myself in a situation where I would stop thinking myself, I stopped evaluating whether my issue could be fixed by just using my damn brain. So I just wanted to stop for a few months, just see what will happen. Tho my biggest issue now: I am a Full-Stack Dev and of course I could again write my code 100% myself, tho using Tools like Claude for writing pipelines tests or even features you are to lazy to do yourself is pretty cool, cant lie about that one. Now I'm asking myself the ethical question whether its fine using AI in that field because I still "boycott"/stop using AI in other fields... What are yalls thoughts on this one?
